    AI Overview
    +4
    The copyright symbol (©) indicates that a creative work is protected by intellectual property law. It is typically formatted in a notice as: © [Year] [Copyright Owner Name]. 
    You can quickly type the symbol on your device using these exact methods: 
    • Windows: Hold the ALT key and type 0169 on the numeric keypad.
    • Mac: Press Option + G.
    • Mobile (iOS/Android): Open your emoji keyboard, go to the symbol/punctuation section, and tap ©. 
    While the symbol is no longer legally mandatory in most nations to assert a new copyright, displaying it provides a clear public notice that your work cannot be reproduced without permission. For specialized design projects or coding, you can download vector assets and find font-specific usage details via Font Awesome.
